title: Nvidia reverses course and brings Jensen Huang back as CEO
lede: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and president less than two weeks after he resigned, having consulted senior government officials on national security.

points: Shares opened 30% higher and stood at $159.95, up 27%, at 9:51 a.m. ET.
Days earlier, board chair Harvey C. Jones said on the earnings call there was no plan to bring Huang back, and Heidrick & Struggles was hunting for a successor.
Elon Musk, Amjad Masad, Tim Sweeney, Travis Kalanick and Garry Tan were among those who signed a petition for his return.
The board said meetings with Huang left it satisfied with his candor and his ability to lead.
Colette Kress, interim CEO during his absence, stays on as CFO.

sections.text: The world's most valuable chipmaker is back under its co-founder, and its board based the national security judgment on input from government officials rather than an independent finding.
